name: Fraunhofer ISE Energy-Charts API
covers: Electricity generation by production type for eight European countries across 2025, at each country's native resolution — quarter-hourly for Spain, Poland, the Netherlands and Austria, hourly for France, Belgium, Italy and Denmark
note: CC BY 4.0, no key. Derived from ENTSO-E transparency data, which covers transmission-connected plant: rooftop solar is largely invisible and the solar share is understated everywhere, most in the sunniest countries.

name: ENTSO-E Transparency Platform
covers: The originating source for European generation and load data
note: Cited for provenance. Energy-Charts is what this analysis reads, because the ENTSO-E API requires a registered token and this project uses only sources reachable without an account.

name: Bundesnetzagentur / SMARD
covers: Day-ahead market prices per bidding zone, 2025, in EUR per MWh
note: Served through the same Energy-Charts endpoint and licensed CC BY 4.0. These are settled day-ahead auction prices, so a negative price is a real cleared price rather than a model output.
